posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
WTF is this cover? c_c That’s a real choice with the style…

It’s absolutely been a weird year.

I dearly love Adam’s description of this as being “an athleticism”. XD

Oh god, I’ve had “Higher” stuck in my head for days for no good reason and I only just got it out, guys!

“…and then you put away the Chrono-Ranger deck and get a new deck.” More things need to be described this way lmao

I’m here for Aata and Arataki being the best Hakas. Canon.

They’re right that you could skip this issue, it’s mostly just moving pieces around. But I like how intensely interesting each of those pieces is. This issue totally justifies itself when it might otherwise be a hard sell.

Gremlins being intentionall inconsistent is cool.

It just goes to show short letters do not necessarily beget shorter or less valuable answers!
